verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a Disputes API for automating dispute management. Its agent toolkit and MCP server expose `list_disputes` and `get_dispute` for retrieval, and `accept_dispute_claim` as the only documented response action, which resolves the dispute in the buyer's favor. The evidence documents no agent tool or API endpoint for assembling and submitting evidence to contest a dispute, so the end-to-end flow is only half covered. Missing for 10: a documented evidence-upload/submit-response endpoint or agent tool, any way to contest (not just accept) a claim, and hands-on corroboration of an agent completing a dispute.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API

citations.quote: disputes (`list_disputes`, `get_dispute`, `accept_dispute_claim` — "Accept a dispute claim, resolving it in favor of the buyer")
Disputes API: A programmatic interface that enables you to automate dispute management actions directly from your systems.
Integrate with PayPal APIs to access orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details, and dispute management through pre-built functions.
